content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals for Data Analysts
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Relational Databases
   - Lesson 2: Creating, Altering, and Dropping Tables
   - Lesson 3: Basic CRUD Operations with Data (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
   - Lesson 4: Data Selection with SELECT Statement
   - Lesson 5: Using WHERE Clause for Filtering Records
   - Lesson 6: Understanding Joins: INNER, OUTER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL
   - Lesson 7: Working with Subqueries and Nested Queries
   - Lesson 8: Sorting Data with ORDER BY Clause
   - Lesson 9: Grouping Records with GROUP BY Clause
   - Lesson 10: Aggregations and Common Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN)

   Track: Python for Data Analysis (Pandas & NumPy)
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python, Pandas, and NumPy Libraries
   - Lesson 2: Importing and Exporting Data with Pandas
   - Lesson 3: Manipulating Data using Indexing, Slicing, and Reshaping
   - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning Techniques (Handling Missing Values, Duplicates)
   - Lesson 5: Working with Time Series Data (datetime, resample)
   - Lesson 6: Grouping and Aggregating Data with Pandas
   - Lesson 7: Merging and Joining Multiple DataFrames
   - Lesson 8: Introduction to Data Visualization using Matplotlib
   - Lesson 9: Creating Line Charts, Bar Plots, and Scatter Plots
   - Lesson 10: Building Data Dashboards with Plotly or Bokeh

   Track: Excel for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Microsoft Excel for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 2: Using Pivot Tables for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 3: Advanced Formulas and Functions (IF, VLOOKUP, INDEX)
   - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning Techniques with Conditional Formatting
   - Lesson 5: Filtering and Sorting Data using Autofilter and Advanced Filter
   - Lesson 6: Creating Charts and Visualizations (Line, Column, Bar, Area, Scatter)
   - Lesson 7: Data Merging, Consolidating, and Splitting Worksheets
   - Lesson 8: Macros for Automating Repetitive Tasks in Excel
   - Lesson 9: Introduction to Power Query for Data Preparation
   - Lesson 10: Connecting Excel with SQL Databases (ODBC, JDBC)

   Track: Statistics and Probability
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Descriptive Statistics
   - Lesson 2: Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)
   - Lesson 3: Measures of Dispersion (Range, Variance, Standard Deviation)
   - Lesson 4: Correlation and Covariance Analysis
   - Lesson 5: Probability Distributions (Normal, Binomial, Poisson)
   - Lesson 6: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
   - Lesson 7: Chi-Square Tests for Goodness of Fit and Independence
   - Lesson 8: T-Tests for Differences between Two Means
   - Lesson 9: ANOVA for Comparing More Than Two Groups
   - Lesson 10: Regression Analysis for Predicting Outcomes

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preparation
   - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values (Imputation Techniques)
   - Lesson 2: Data Normalization and Standardization
   - Lesson 3: Dealing with Skewed Distributions using Transformations
   - Lesson 4: One-Hot Encoding for Categorical Variables
   - Lesson 5: Feature Engineering Techniques (Creating Derived Features)
   - Lesson 6: Handling Outliers and Anomalies in Data
   - Lesson 7: Handling Imbalanced Datasets using SMOTE or Resampling Methods
   - Lesson 8: External Merging and Matching Data Using Fuzzy Logic
   - Lesson 9: Data Augmentation Techniques for Increasing Sample Size
   - Lesson 10: Splitting Datasets for Model Training, Validation, and Testing

   Track: Data Modeling & Machine Learning Fundamentals
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Supervised Learning Algorithms
   - Lesson 2: Linear Regression for Continuous Predictions
   - Lesson 3: Logistic Regression for Binary Classification
   - Lesson 4: Decision Trees and Random Forests
   - Lesson 5: Support Vector Machines (SVM)
   - Lesson 6: Neural Networks and Deep Learning Basics
   - Lesson 7: Ensemble Methods for Improving Model Performance
   - Lesson 8: Overfitting, Underfitting, and Regularization Techniques
   - Lesson 9: Cross-Validation, Hyperparameter Tuning, and Grid Search
   - Lesson 10: Model Evaluation Metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 Score)
